d:
From our upcoming album ‘Come Home Christmas’, here is a song that will help remind us that the story of Christmas was indeed of Middle Eastern origin. And to have collaborated with Israel’s Got Talent finalist, Ilana Yahav (sand artist), makes this experience all the more special. It's sung in Urdu, Farsi & English.
